resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1932 L-4 cab and the 1972 R-6 cab are different structures on the same site; the register's 1972 build year refers to the current cab.

notes_for_editor: All three pages agree on the 1932 L-4 cab, 1952 base and 1972 R-6 cab, and on the 7,077 ft elevation. Record height_m 3.0 is close to the 10-foot base (3.05 m), not an overall structure height; left unchanged. Record kind two_story is consistent with a cab on a 10-foot base; not changed. Access is only the hike-in and staffed notes from Idaho Fire Lookouts; no visiting rules found. The AllTrails trail page returned HTTP 403, so no trail length or route was verified. The Idaho Fire Lookouts staff list was read only as far as its visible portion (to 2009); staff names were not reproduced.
